Spongy_Mycelium_Network_Chassis.description: The Spongy Mycelium Network Chassis is a resilient fungal core that intertwines through the host’s body, enhancing their mental fortitude and connection to the natural world while subtly sapping physical strength, granting the entity an innate ability to regenerate wounds from the deep, ancient wisdom of the fungal kingdom.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Core.description: Embedded within the creature's dense, fungal mass is a hardened core, a chitinous nucleus that grants it an impenetrable natural armor, though at the cost of its agility, making it a formidable opponent that can withstand harsh impacts and resist being knocked back, skills honed through relentless combat in the darkest corners of the fungal realm.

Toxic_Puffball_Swarm_Frame.description: This ethereal fungal construct, a toxic puffball swarm, skitters and hovers through darkened corridors, its body a pulsating mass of spore-filled sacs that release a choking cloud of venomous spores upon command, while its innate agility and resilience allow it to evade and endure in the most treacherous environments.

Luminescent_Bioluminescent_Stalk_Chassis.description: Rooted deep within the fungal caverns, the Luminescent Bioluminescent Stalk Chassis is a towering core of ancient magic, its ethereal glow pulsating with arcane energy, enhancing the wisdom and perception of those who bond with it, while granting the abilities to cast light and detect magical auras.

Symbiotic_Wood_Decay_Core.description: Embedded deep within the organism, the Symbiotic Wood Decay Core thrums with a fungal vitality, its tendrils weaving through the host's flesh and bark, enhancing their resilience and strength while granting the ability to sunder and regenerate, a potent combination for those who dwell in the decaying heart of the forest.

Parasitic_Cordyceps_Host_Frame.description: The Parasitic Cordyceps Host Frame is a grotesque amalgamation of twisted fungal growths and corrupted flesh, its once-human form now a snarling vessel of pure aggression, with cordyceps tendrils coiling around its body, enhancing its physical strength while dulling its mental acuity.

Gargantuan_Toadstool_Monolith_Chassis.description: Enormous and primordial, the Gargantuan Toadstool Monolith Chassis is a towering fungal construct, its thick, resilient body pulsating with an aura of ancient magic and brute strength, granting its wielder immense constitution but at the cost of agility, making it a formidable presence on the battlefield.

Slime_Mold_Amoebic_Core.description: The Slime_Mold_Amoebic_Core is a pulsating, gelatinous mass that thrives in damp, shadowy environments, its fluidic form allowing it to ooze and contort with unnatural agility, while granting its host unparalleled dexterity and the uncanny ability to traverse treacherous terrains with ease.

Spore_Cloud_Zeppelin_Frame.description: This ethereal construct is a fungal masterpiece, a zeppelin-like frame that hums with the arcane energy of floating spores, allowing it to glide through the air with an eerie grace while bestowing upon its wielder the ability to levitate and summon a choking poison cloud, at the cost of raw strength for enhanced wisdom.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Chassis.description: Embedded within the entity's core, the crystalline underdark fungus chassis glows with an eerie luminescence, its chitinous armor hardening into a resilient crystalline structure that enhances its natural defenses and grants it an innate wisdom born from the depths of the dark realm, alongside the ability to see in the darkest of tunnels and reflect harmful spells back at their caster.
